_about: Thucydides in English, translator per title. Benjamin Jowett (1881, 2 vols.: vol. 1 the translation with marginal analysis, vol. 2 notes and essays), raw IA OCR. Thomas Hobbes (1629), in the 1841 Oxford corrected edition, raw IA OCR. Richard Crawley (1874) is already held on the Adler shelf as thucydides-pelo (PG 7142) and cross-referenced. Older translations from the wishlist added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row). Perseus TEI English (section "perseus", fetched by pipeline/fetch_perseus.py): translations published in or before 1930; the TEI markup is Perseus Digital Library's, CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution + share-alike), recorded per file in the report.

thucydides-jowett-1881-v2: Thucydides translated into English, vol. 2: notes (Oxford, 1881)
thucydides-hobbes-1841: Thucydides, chiefly from the translation of Hobbes of Malmesbury (Oxford, 1841)
thucydides-smith-v1: Thucydides, tr. by W. Smith, vol. 1 (1831)
thucydides-smith-v2: Thucydides, tr. by W. Smith, vol. 2 (1831)
thucydides-smith-v3: Thucydides, tr. by W. Smith, vol. 3 (1831)

_cross_ref.thucydides-pelo: Adler shelf: PG 7142, which is Richard CRAWLEY's translation; the Adler shelf labels it 'tr. Jowett', which is wrong (PG 7142's own header names Crawley)

_excluded.C. F. Smith, Loeb (1919-23): on Perseus, US PD by date; pending

thucydides-perseus-smith-history-of-the-: Translation published 1923: US public domain (in or before 1930). Perseus source line: Thucydides, Vol. 1-4. Smith, Charles Foster, translator. London and Cambridge, MA: Heinemann and Harvard University Press, 1919-1923.
thucydides-perseus-dale-history-of-the-p: Translation published 1852: US public domain (in or before 1930). Perseus source line: Thucydides. The history of the Peloponnesian War, Volume 1-2. Dale, Henry, translator. London: Heinemann and Henry G. Bohn, 1851-1852.
thucydides-perseus-hobbes-the-history-of: The History of the Grecian War
